editorial: Strap yourself in and hold your breath because your palms will be sweating from the opening frame. You are thrust into a visceral nightmare where the lush Thai landscape becomes a jagged, vertical prison. Michael Spierig masterfully weaponizes negative space, making the empty air feel like a physical predator closing in on you. It is a grueling exercise in sensory dread that refuses to let you look away. If you crave a high-altitude panic attack that pushes the limits of cinematic tension, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-stakes survival cinema and atmospheric tension.
